description: A layout Container inside the tree: LayoutType:flex with LayoutConfig (grid placement) on the node itself, and the actual flex/gap/padding CSS-ish values one level down on its Style.
notes: LayoutConfig (colSpan/rowSpan/minRowSpan/maxRowSpan) lives on the Container itself and drives the page's own grid placement; it is separate from the flex CHILD layout rules, which live entirely in Style.Value.
An empty Style.Value ({}) is a fully valid, common state meaning "no layout overrides" — not a placeholder to always fill in.

Container::Container is how the tree nests (a Container's own children are OTHER Containers, which in turn may be Type:Component hosts) — a widget's Container is a LEAF of this tree, see any widget_*.json for that pattern.

This node's own "Container" scalar (its PARENT) points at the well-known literal "Container001" — the page's ever-present root Body container id, not app-specific and safe to reference without re-minting.
